$Comment: The primary station of the fish-prep multi-station exemplar, jar-layer content carrying zero progression. Deliberately thin - the only action is 'prepfish', attached by Ref to the standalone Server/RpgStations/Actions/PrepFish.json, which owns every mechanical group (Custody/Tool/Work/Anchors/Steps). Puppet is authored here at station level (the default for the resolved 'prepfish' action per Puppet's own per-station-default/per-action-override rule - ActionDef.Puppet stays null on PrepFish.json so it inherits this group wholesale): a station whose action authors any Walk step requires Puppet enabled (validator WALK_REQUIRES_PUPPET) - the player stays hidden/held here while the puppet walks to the cooking-fire anchor and back. Hold/Camera mirror the Anvil's proven effect-mode default (the Entity standing-mount spike stays unverified elsewhere in this mod, not reused here).
